create_sawyer_soccer_env: create a SawyerSoccerEnv instance to simulate a Sawyer robot pushing a soccer ball to a goal
run_step_sawyer_soccer: run a step on the SawyerSoccerEnv with an action and get observation, reward, and success info
reset_sawyer_soccer_model: reset the SawyerSoccerEnv model to initialize object position, goal, and hand state
compute_reward_sawyer_soccer: compute the reward for the SawyerSoccerEnv based on reach distance and push distance to goal
adjust_init_obj_pos: adjust the initial object position in SawyerSoccerEnv to account for geom and body center misalignment
